quest.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Lauma
quest.description: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Lauma...

talks.objective: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave to start the tea party
Go to the Frostmoon Enclave to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This is truly delicious herbal tea, Miss Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: So soon? How about I treat you to dinner at the Frostmoon Enclave?
